angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 47,377,170 km at 1546.70 pc = 0.41 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RX Aur: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1546.7 +/- 118.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1546.7 +/- 118.7 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.6182 +/- 0.0211 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98), 29.3 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 68.1 +/- 5.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RX Aur: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 68.1 +/- 5.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 47,377,170 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5500 +/- 302 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 138, Name='RX Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5500 +/- 302 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
